allowed_actions: Retrieve the exact release archive from the authenticated private HSO artifact endpoint
Recompute SHA-256 and verify pinned source blob identities without copying archive contents into the public A.S.F.R.E.E repository
Run the existing RPEDS schema, semantic graph, package and regression checks in an isolated non-commercial GitHub Actions job
Record a host acceptance receipt with exact source, workflow, test and rollback references
prohibited_actions: Copy, extract or commit PRE release source files into the public A.S.F.R.E.E repository
Publish, mirror, redistribute, sublicense or expose the private PRE artifact
Use this acceptance as authorization for commercial deployment or commercial redistribution
Enable automatic adoption or change the host subscription to an unrestricted stable channel
Replace, rename, delete or rewrite the four RPEDS-native modules
Change M00 case authority, O11 security/authorization/privacy controls, O12 evaluation judgment, O10 test authority or O09 runtime authority
Move host-only SOP, private case data, credentials or authority records into the shared DNA

preserved_rpeds_modules.name: Roadmap Architecture Planner
preserved_rpeds_modules.boundary: Owns roadmap decomposition; M00 retains case scope and final arbitration

preserved_rpeds_modules.name: Progressive Development Manager
preserved_rpeds_modules.boundary: Coordinates approved iterations; it does not execute privileged changes itself

preserved_rpeds_modules.name: Continuous Evaluation Engine
preserved_rpeds_modules.boundary: Schedules checkpoints; O12 retains independent evaluation judgment

preserved_rpeds_modules.name: Adaptive Roadmap Optimizer
preserved_rpeds_modules.boundary: Proposes controlled re-plans; M00/O11/O12 approval boundaries remain intact

authority_precedence: A.S.F.R.E.E approved SOP, security and privacy
M00 case scope and authorized decision rights
O11 authorization, security and privacy controls
O12 independent evaluation authority and O10 actual test evidence

reuse_basis.permitted_test_scope: Private, non-commercial research/experiment and compatibility testing only
reuse_basis.pre_source_rights: PRE source package does not currently declare a separate redistribution license in its release manifest; full chain-of-title and broader reuse rights remain UNKNOWN
reuse_basis.restriction: This profile does not grant PRE source redistribution, sublicensing, public mirroring, derivative publication or commercial-use rights
reuse_basis.control: The PRE artifact remains in private Supabase Storage and is fetched only by a short-lived, repo/workflow-scoped GitHub OIDC identity

privacy_data_boundary.transfer: No host case records, credentials, SOP contents or authority data are uploaded to the PRE artifact or HSO release registry
privacy_data_boundary.storage: Only the private release archive and sanitized release evidence are stored in the HSO release system
privacy_data_boundary.public_repo: No PRE archive or PRE source content is committed to this public repository

automation.approval: Workflow acceptance is explicit and event-scoped; it does not enable background auto-adoption

deployment_boundary.verified_meaning: Verified host-side artifact integrity, source compatibility and CI acceptance for the named RPEDS repository and adapter
